title: Edit my recording
summary: Cut the user's own recording: remove silences, fillers and false starts, add subtitles, sync several cameras, reframe to vertical.

notFor.when: the user wants short clips cut out of a long recording
a new film made from stock or supplied b-roll cut to music, not the user's speech
a screencast or tutorial of a product the user recorded
subtitles or a voice in another language than the one spoken
a creator-style product ad: a person on camera selling a product for TikTok, Reels or Shorts ads
many clips of an event the user filmed, cut to music as an aftermovie or recap
a recorded client interview made into a customer case study or testimonial film

alternatives.when: the selections are already decided and only need materialising as a reviewed recording edit

qa: No cut breaks a sentence's meaning; caveats, deliberate repetitions and the beat after a point are kept
No dead air over about 0.5 s left uncut unless the user kept it; breaths before a new thought kept
Captions timed to the words, inside the platform safe zone and off faces
Audio joins have no clicks or hiss steps; loudness even across cuts
Punch-ins and vertical crops keep the whole face; source enlargement under 2x

intake.ask: What kind of recording is it: talking head, podcast or interview, lecture, vlog?
intake.why: The kind sets the pause lengths, the cover for jump cuts and whether chapters are needed (see variants)

intake.ask: Where will it be published, and in which formats (landscape, vertical, square)?
intake.why: Each platform profile fixes formats, length, caption style and the crop work

intake.ask: May we pay for Scribe transcription? Filler and 'um' removal needs it
intake.why: speech:local is free but not verbatim; paid transcription needs the user's go-ahead and the cost footage:next prints

intake.ask: How many people speak, and how many cameras or separate recordings are there?
intake.why: Speaker labels (--speakers), multicam:sync and the speaker map for a vertical crop depend on it

intake.ask: Burned subtitles, a separate SRT file, or none? In which style?
intake.why: A landscape YouTube upload usually takes a clean render with an SRT; vertical feeds take burned captions
intake.default: burned for vertical and square, SRT for landscape

intake.ask: Is anything off limits to cut: a joke, a pause, a reaction, a repeated phrase?
intake.why: Protects meaning the plan cannot see; those cuts go into --reject from the start
intake.default: nothing beyond the playbook's step 3 list

profiles.note: Clean render plus an SRT from captions:export; chapters need 3+ timestamps from 00:00, each 10 s or longer; playback turns loud audio down to about -14 LUFS, never up (measured); band is a house rule
Only when the user wants the whole recording vertical; TikTok's ads spec page takes 9:16 up to 10 minutes (band is a house rule); longer talks become shorts-from-long
Reels upload up to 3 minutes (Instagram, January 2025); band is a house rule
Shorts run up to 3 minutes; a Short over 1 minute with any copyright claim is blocked, so keep third-party music out or stay at 60 s; minimum is a house rule
LinkedIn takes 3 s to 15 min at 1:2.4 to 2.4:1; burn calm captions for a feed watched muted (band is a house rule)

starter.note: clean-sentence or line-box for long talk, lessons and two speakers; outline-pop for vertical talking heads (caption styles table in the captions-and-localization skill)

variants.title: Video podcast or interview
variants.changes: Speaker labels (--speakers N) and multicam angles per speaker; sentence pauses stay at 400 ms and a guest's thinking pause is kept; captions break at speaker changes (clean-sentence or line-box, never word-box); YouTube chapters from the recut's SRT; the vertical crop follows the speaker map; a type-lower-third overlay names each speaker on first appearance (timeline:edit add-overlay, ground transparent)

variants.title: Lecture or course recording
variants.changes: Slower pace (defaults, the beat after a new idea kept); a slide recording of the same session is synced with multicam:sync and cut to by hand while a slide is explained (multicam:angles picks by speaker); calm clean-sentence captions; chapters per topic; no punch-ins

variants.title: Vlog
variants.changes: Faster pace (--mid-pause-ms 250 --sentence-pause-ms 300); jump cuts left visible or covered by --punch-in 1.1; the user's own clips as B-roll over joins with media:broll; outline-pop or italic-shadow captions
